scripts.build: pnpm --filter @logscope/config build && pnpm --filter @logscope/contracts build && pnpm --filter @logscope/elasticsearch build && nest build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.start:dev: pnpm --filter @logscope/config build && pnpm --filter @logscope/contracts build && pnpm --filter @logscope/elasticsearch build && nest start --watch
scripts.start:debug: pnpm --filter @logscope/config build && pnpm --filter @logscope/contracts build && pnpm --filter @logscope/elasticsearch build && nest start --debug --watch
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @logscope/config build && pnpm --filter @logscope/contracts build && pnpm --filter @logscope/elasticsearch build && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @logscope/config build && pnpm --filter @logscope/contracts build && pnpm --filter @logscope/elasticsearch build && jest
scripts.test:cov: pnpm --filter @logscope/config build && pnpm --filter @logscope/contracts build && pnpm --filter @logscope/elasticsearch build && jest --coverage
scripts.test:ci: pnpm --filter @logscope/config build && pnpm --filter @logscope/contracts build && pnpm --filter @logscope/elasticsearch build && jest --runInBand --coverage
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @logscope/config build && pnpm --filter @logscope/contracts build && pnpm --filter @logscope/elasticsearch build && jest --config ./test/jest-e2e.json --runInBand
